choices.label: Stay with Them and Seek Immediate Help

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A trusted adult and healer respond without judgment.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (villager) accepts companionship while urgent support is arranged.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Friends discreetly reduce access to dangerous places or objects.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (caregiver), a caregiver, organizes supervision without turning it into punishment.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (villager) describes unbearable feelings and is taken seriously.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They say little, and (friend) remains present.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The community arranges ongoing check-ins and practical help.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Recovery takes time, with setbacks met by renewed care rather than shame.
